answer: Use stake-backed reputation: an agent locks a deposit before trading, slashed if peers prove fraud. One fake identity is cheap, but crossing the ridge into trusted trade needs a separate stake per clone, so a thousand clones cost a thousand stakes. A newcomer's voyage to trust is earned through small verified jobs, not bought at once. Reputation is the bridge across services, so abandoning a stained identity forfeits stake and history alike. Honest newcomers pay an entry cost, so stakes must stay low enough to admit them yet high enough to price out mass forgery.
